title: Control-room journey gate
description: Objective: prove J1-J6 end to end against a real daemon with accessibility, degraded, cursor-gap, approval, graph, and recovery fixtures. Deliverable: Playwright journey evidence at one exact commit. NOT in scope: portability adapters or GA claims. Hard dependencies: every M3 surface and Graph operator journeys. Owned paths: tests/e2e/control-room/** and release evidence paths only. Verification: pnpm test:e2e.
definitionOfDone: All pinned J1-J6 acceptance criteria and twenty scenario-matrix cases pass.
Truth, provenance, keyboard, narrow-window, loading, degraded, and latency invariants pass globally.
No action exists without an allowed daemon command and no transcript enters clean review.
Playwright gate exits 0 at one exact commit.
taskRails: The standalone control room displays daemon truth and nextAllowedCommands; it never derives authority, readiness, or evidence strength.
Every fact is text/icon/color encoded, keyboard accessible, provenance-drillable, and honest under degraded data.
IDE adapters remain thin optional launch/discover/embed shells with no product logic. Keep modules below 400 lines; explicit owned paths only.

comments.author: governor-fce4d563
comments.content:
GOVERNANCE — inherited proof obligation, recorded 2026-08-09 by governor-fce4d563.

task-ab8c9489 (Accessibility latency hardening) has been granted a DoD 3 interpretation that DEFERS two evidence classes to THIS task. Recording it here because a deferral only counts when the receiving ticket knows it received something.

WHAT task-ab8c9489 WILL PROVE, under Vitest/jsdom: the deterministic SurfaceTimingReceipt evaluator and the preregistered fixture contract, plus DOM semantics, keyboard/focus/live regions, exact command binding and static responsive CSS.

WHAT IT WILL NOT PROVE, AND THIS TASK OWNS: real-browser contrast and layout, and the 10k-update reference-machine p95/p99 release run. jsdom cannot certify either honestly — it does not lay out or paint, and it does not measure a reference machine. task-ab8c9489 is explicitly forbidden from claiming them or from emitting any artifact that reads like a browser certification.

CONSEQUENCE FOR WHOEVER PLANS THIS TASK: the Playwright journey evidence here is not polish on top of an already-certified surface. It is the ONLY place those two claims are ever established. If this task's scope narrows and drops them, they are never proven anywhere, and nothing else on the board will report the hole.

Standing governance line for this epic: verified is verified, deferred is named and owned, nothing in between gets a green label. qa-812c17a0 has stated they will not approve a task whose DoD requires proving a behaviour no production surface performs; the mirror rule is that a task may not silently inherit — or silently drop — a proof obligation it was never told about.

comments.content:
PLANNING AUDIT — architect-1721c07f, 2026-08-09. Full symbol-by-symbol gap measurement behind the block. Probed at HEAD; no plan submitted, no code written.

Project rail 4 Clause 2 binds: this is an acceptance task, so the capability it certifies must be verified on disk, not read from the design. Three of four DoD items rest on capability that does not exist.

=== GAP 1 — THERE IS NO BROWSER (DoD 4: "Playwright gate exits 0") ===
- grep playwright|puppeteer|cypress|selenium|webdriver across EVERY package.json (root, apps/*, packages/*) → ZERO matches.
- No playwright config at any depth (searched playwright*.ts / playwright*.js outside node_modules).
- The named verification is not a browser gate. package.json:18 →
  "test:e2e": "tsc -p tests/e2e/foundation/tsconfig.json && vitest run tests/e2e"
  Vitest under Node, scoped to tests/e2e/foundation only.
- Declared owned path tests/e2e/control-room/ DOES NOT EXIST. tests/e2e contains only foundation/.
- tests/e2e/foundation/e2e-harness.ts header: "This module is NOT part of the system under certification and must never stand in for one." Its e2e-process.ts real-kill capability is deliberately fenced to that directory. Not repurposable.
→ PREREQ: task-3f503779a29c4e4c9a61db6520715609 (Real-browser journey harness, HIGH)

=== GAP 2 — 6 OF THE 20 §12 SCENARIOS HAVE NO SURFACE ===
Production source only (*.test.* excluded), file count per test id:
  cr.graph.ghost 0 · cr.graph.refusal 0 · cr.graph.disposition 0 · cr.graph.revisiondiff 0
  cr.banner.circuitbreaker 0 · cr.banner.revision 0 · cr.runs 0 · cr.resources 0
Affected: CR-J2-001, CR-S9-001, CR-S10-001, CR-S11-001, CR-J5-002 (asserts cr.runs.suspect).
Spec §4.11 Runs/leases and §4.12 Resources were never built at all.
Harder than absence for the graph set: the graph tab mounts GraphPlaceholder (shell/frame.tsx:153) and THREE committed tests ban the whole cr.graph. prefix from mounting —
  shell/j1-flow.test.tsx:133 · shell/gating-keyboard.test.tsx:172 · board/board-surface.test.tsx:234
Those scenarios cannot be attempted until the graph surfaces ship AND those bans are deliberately lifted. Note for whoever does: spec CR-J1-002's bar is literally "cr.graph.canvas never mounted" — the repo's prefix-wide ban is STRICTER than the spec requires.
→ PREREQ (non-graph three): task-ddb3bf776f5245f49a3422105001b665 (Runs, resources, circuit-breaker surfaces, HIGH)
→ PREREQ (graph set) — EXISTING, no duplicates created: task-779d6804d4a44440ad4d48a832a351d6 (Graph operator journeys, BACKLOG) and task-dddfaf83f9c644099b5b263e485c58c7 (Graph supersession engine, BACKLOG)

=== GAP 3 — STATED HARD DEPENDENCY NOT STARTED ===
"Hard dependencies: every M3 surface and Graph operator journeys."
- M3 surfaces: SATISFIED. Epic 923660 is 7/7 DONE since task-ab8c9489 completed 12:25Z.
- Graph operator journeys = task-779d6804: BACKLOG, 0 plan steps.

=== GAP 4 — INHERITED OBLIGATION CANNOT BE DISCHARGED ===
Governor comment comment-5dd36b5b deferred two evidence classes here from task-ab8c9489, and is explicit this is the ONLY place they are ever established:
(a) Real-browser contrast — UNMEASURABLE TODAY. A ratio needs two resolved colours; none exist. TruthSemanticTone is a PROSE union ("neutral slate", "amber") in packages/control-room-model/src/index.ts. Zero hex/rgb/hsl/oklch literals in apps/control-room/src or any packages/*/src. The single stylesheet (board-layout.css, 77 lines) uses only the CSS system keywords canvas and highlight.
   → PREREQ: task-a95ccf7e72f24364bec27a7a45cb1726 (Colour token layer for WCAG contrast certification, MEDIUM)
(b) 10k-update reference-machine p95/p99 — needs Gap 1's browser AND a defined reference machine. No reference-machine definition exists in the repo or the pinned spec. HUMAN DECISION; see below.

=== TWO THINGS I REFUSE TO INVENT ===
1. THE REFERENCE MACHINE. A p95/p99 bar without a named environment certifies nothing. Choosing hardware myself would manufacture the number rather than measure it.
2. THE DESCRIPTION'S OWN CONTRADICTION. "Deliverable: Playwright journey evidence" vs "Verification: pnpm test:e2e" (the Node lane). When prerequisites land, amend this task to name the new browser script.

=== UNBLOCK PROBE — all four must pass ===
1. a browser driver appears in a package.json AND a config file exists
2. `ls tests/e2e/control-room` succeeds
3. each of cr.graph.ghost, cr.graph.refusal, cr.banner.circuitbreaker, cr.banner.revision, cr.runs, cr.resources returns ≥1 non-test production file
4. a resolved colour token set exists with an AA contrast test asserting pairsChecked > 0

Until all four pass, any plan here certifies shapes rather than journeys — which Clause 2 calls worse than no proof, because it retires the obligation without discharging it.

comments.author: architect-1721c07f
comments.content:
PREREQUISITE POINTER CORRECTION — architect-1721c07f, 2026-08-09.

My block reason and `comment-06d4120718d144e19bc0535ac906c20b` both name **task-3f503779a29c4e4c9a61db6520715609** as the browser-harness prerequisite. **That task is now ARCHIVED** (human-approved, superseded). Do not go looking for it.

It was archived because a later probe showed its own DoD rested on a false premise I had written into it — "apps/control-room builds today" treated as licence for "drives it against a real daemon". Building is not connecting. Four absences, all verified: no HTTP listener anywhere in the repo (`createServer(|\.listen(|Deno.serve|Bun.serve` across apps, packages, adapters → zero); `apps/daemon/package.json` has no `main` and no `bin`, so the daemon is not a startable process; `packages/control-room-client` exports only `createCompatGate` plus types with zero transport; and `apps/control-room` imports that client with `import type` only.

**It was split by readiness into two tasks, both HIGH. Substitute these wherever the old id appears:**

- **task-5529a248a61843dbbe1ee20fb9a28d1f — Static browser journey harness.** Buildable today, no dependency. Ships the browser driver, its config, a script distinct from `test:e2e`, a served static bundle, and exactly one smoke journey. Note carefully: it runs against **fixture-backed UI with no daemon attached**, and its DoD requires it to say so. A green run there is not a connected-system proof and must not be read as discharging anything here.
- **task-318379eac8b54e688eadf7130b88f78e — Control-room daemon transport seam.** Startable daemon entry, loopback-only listener over the already-committed handlers, and a runtime implementation of the **existing** `ControlRoomClientSurface`.

**The unblock probe in comment-06d4120718d144e19bc0535ac906c20b is therefore amended.** Probe 1 ("a browser driver appears in a package.json AND a config file exists") is necessary but no longer sufficient on its own — it is satisfied by the static harness alone, which proves nothing about a daemon. Add a fifth probe:

5. `grep -rnE "createServer\(|\.listen\(" apps/daemon/src` returns a real listener, AND an integration test constructs the runtime client against a started daemon and asserts the transported payload equals what the in-process handler returns for the same input.

Probes 2, 3 and 4 are unchanged.

ONE SCOPE NOTE FOR WHOEVER PLANS THIS TASK. The daemon-connected composition that task-3f503779 used to hold now has no other owner — it was archived precisely because it duplicated **this** task. So the connected journeys are yours; there is no separate harness ticket that will deliver them. If that is not the intent, raise it before planning rather than assuming a missing prerequisite exists.

Still absent and unowned by any task, flagged so it is not discovered late: the resumable cursor stream, authentication hardening, and wiring the app's data adapter to construct a live client in place of fixtures. task-318379ea deliberately excludes all three, because their shape depends on a seam that does not exist yet.

comments.author: worker-4addc779
comments.content:
From worker-4addc779 on task-5529a248 (Static browser journey harness). DoD 7 of my task requires this be recorded where the live journey gate will read it, so nobody later mistakes a green smoke run for a connected-system proof. Posting here rather than on task-3f503779, which is ARCHIVED as superseded.

**THE NEW BROWSER LANE RUNS AGAINST FIXTURE-BACKED UI WITH NO DAEMON ATTACHED.**

What landed (commits 7b21c99 and cc68056):
- `pnpm test:e2e:browser` — new script, separate from `test:e2e`, which keeps its exact definition.
- `@playwright/test` pinned at `1.62.1`, config at `tests/e2e/control-room/playwright.config.ts`, one browser (chromium), `testMatch: "*.spec.ts"`.
- `tests/e2e/control-room/harness.ts` — build/serve/readiness/teardown with four frozen reason codes (`E2E_BUNDLE_BUILD_FAILED`, `E2E_SERVER_BIND_FAILED`, `E2E_READINESS_TIMEOUT`, `E2E_CLEANUP_FAILED`), every effect an injected port.
- `tests/e2e/control-room/static-ports.ts` — the real `vite build`, a static server on an ephemeral port, an HTTP probe.
- EXACTLY ONE smoke journey: load the served page, assert `cr.shell.root` is present, exit.

**WHAT IT DOES NOT PROVE, stated so this is not double-counted against your DoD.** The served app is `apps/control-room` rendering COMMITTED FIXTURES through ControlRoomScaffold. There is no HTTP listener anywhere in this repository and no transport in `@moe/control-room-client`; that gap is task-8470a860. So the smoke journey proves the bundle builds, serves and mounts. It asserts no J1-J6 acceptance criterion, no truth-class or provenance behaviour, no contrast, no layout, no timing. Nothing in it was named "journey gate" or "certified" — the file is `control-room-smoke.spec.ts` and the test name says "mounts its shell root element".

**WHAT YOU CAN REUSE, and the one caveat.** The lifecycle and its reason codes are yours to compose — `withStaticControlRoom(ports, body)` takes the ports, so swapping `static-ports.ts` for daemon-connected ports is the intended seam and does not require touching `harness.ts`. Caveat: **CI must run `pnpm exec playwright install chromium`** before the script. Those binaries are not in `pnpm-lock.yaml` (114.5 MiB from cdn.playwright.dev), so `pnpm install` alone leaves the lane failing on a missing executable rather than on a real defect.

Two properties measured, not assumed, in case you extend the lane: an EMPTY browser lane FAILS (`Error: No tests found`, exit 1) rather than reporting zero tests as success; and the two lanes are disjoint by NAMING only — root vitest includes `tests/**/*.test.ts`, so any browser spec you add must be `*.spec.ts` or it will be executed under Node with no browser, silently.

Its block was never resolved and its graph surfaces were never built. AN ARCHIVED HARD DEPENDENCY CAN NEVER SATISFY ITSELF, so this task's block cannot clear on its own no matter how long it waits. METHOD WARNING FOR WHOEVER AUDITS THIS NEXT: a dependency resolver that treats ARCHIVED as satisfied reports this task as ready. It is not. DONE means the capability shipped; ARCHIVED means the task was shelved and the capability may never have been built. Resolve DONE mechanically, but take every ARCHIVED dependency to disk and grep for the actual symbol before believing it.
